candidate_practices.name: Specify what the existing signal misses
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish a target property from a convenient measurement or training signal.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes changing the signal a substantive contribution.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'better metric/objective' with the omitted property, its operational signal, and the decision that signal changes.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the replacement's relationship to the target remains undefined.

support.specific_example: FAC replaces textual variation with feature coverage and guides missing-feature synthesis.
Motion-weighted masks target temporal influence before clip curation.
BLL limits low-probability-token influence after distinguishing reasoning validity from wording.
An MI proxy targets cross-input distinguishability missed by entropy.

contrasts.contrast: OPUS changes utility geometry to effective optimizer updates; it does not merely replace an evaluation metric.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Signal definitions, validity, and whether intervention gains substantiate the proposed explanation.

candidate_practices.name: Describe components through decisions and feedback
candidate_practices.source_observation: The abstracts assign operational roles to policies, modules, and refinement stages.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can reconstruct the method's operation instead of memorizing component names.
candidate_practices.application: For each essential component, state its input, decision or transformation, and feedback when present.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent distinct causal roles for inseparable components.

support.specific_example: An MDP policy maps token confidences to unmasking decisions.
Latent dynamics and intrinsic rewards support counterfactual sensing and movement.
Independent outer optimization streams accompany inner multi-timescale fusion.
Pixel differences supply guidance; LoRA supports adaptation; local quality modulates prior weighting.

contrasts.contrast: Exposure bias motivates training interventions, without requiring a runtime feedback loop.
Step-specific SOP injection is operationally named, but Cognitive Drift remains unquantified in the extraction.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Component interactions and evidence isolating their effects.

candidate_practices.name: Keep comparison conditions beside the result
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts retain training regime, matched inputs, or resource conditions in comparative claims.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the claim becomes a conditional author decision rather than an unrestricted ranking.
candidate_practices.application: Write 'under X, relative to Y, with Z held fixed' before the gain or trade-off.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not imply matching beyond the variables actually controlled.

support.specific_example: SGD's favorable RL comparison is distinguished from optimizer behavior in SFT.
Kimi-Dev comparison retains the same base model and scaffold, with 73.1B mid-training tokens.
Blind and interface-informed accuracy comparisons are separated; runtime names hardware and complex size.
At fixed capability, smaller models with more reasoning effort trade compute for monitorability.

contrasts.contrast: High-concurrency framing identifies the target regime, but maximum speedups lack workload conditions here.
FLOP savings and retained accuracy specify an efficiency trade-off, not measured walltime.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Baseline configurations, denominators, budgets, and comparison protocols.

candidate_practices.name: Make resource design answer the evaluation gap
candidate_practices.source_observation: Benchmark contributions specify changes in coverage, splits, annotations, or source construction.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: resource value becomes an identifiable measurement capability.
candidate_practices.application: Name the previously untestable distinction and the dataset or protocol feature enabling it.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: A larger collection alone cannot substantiate diagnostic validity or realism.

support.specific_example: MADQA pairs document questions with effort measurement; human-level accuracy masks different solved questions.
User-intent tasks, capability annotations, and environment variations expose distinct failures.
FLIP2 adds engineering domains and generalization splits, reports simple-model competitiveness, and records provenance and licensing.
TEDBench and MiAE form a benchmark-plus-method contribution with an experimental-structure transfer evaluation.

contrasts.contrast: Photos, a reward model, and a test set serve different evaluation roles; their relationship needs clarification.
Synthetic workflow tasks support process findings while positioning real-world annotation as future work.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Construction, splits, annotation reliability, release contents, and transfer outcomes.

candidate_practices.name: State the assumption change and exact guarantee
candidate_practices.source_observation: Theoretical abstracts retain conditions, parameter dependence, and different forms of convergence.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: novelty can be assessed as a changed theorem scope.
candidate_practices.application: Place setting, relaxed assumption, guarantee target, and qualifying condition together.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not replace an unavailable theorem statement with an unqualified optimality claim.

support.specific_example: Sufficiently small one-sided perturbation preserves an equilibrium strategy and supports linear last-iterate convergence.
A nonfinite semi-algebraic domain accompanies asymptotic convergence; finite recovery requires a rank condition.
Auction bounds retain grid, approximation-error, and round-complexity dependence.
Tabular regret has a matching lower bound up to logarithms; broader structured-transition results are separately introduced.

contrasts.contrast: Removing boundedness assumptions yields a stationary-point rate, not global optimality.
An optimal search framework and a guided beam variant should retain separate guarantee descriptions.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Complete assumptions, theorem targets, constants, and proof scope.

candidate_practices.name: Connect a formal object to an enabled operation
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts link mathematical formulations to estimators, inference, or manipulation.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: theory's role becomes concrete without treating it as empirical validation.
candidate_practices.application: State the mathematical object, the relationship established, and the operation it enables.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not label a motivating analogy as an equivalence or theorem.

support.specific_example: Attention can recover normalized KDE; joint density/score estimation supplies plug-in score operations.
A conditional-expectation formulation of carré du champ enables sample-wise training and amortized inference.
Engram criteria become an inverse problem with a closed-form estimator and linear memory operations.
Binary terminal feedback motivates a likelihood and a compute-indexed objective family.

contrasts.contrast: Adaptive chunking and reported biological hierarchy discovery do not establish a formal biological equivalence.
Update-conditioning theory and preserved parallel-scan complexity are distinct supporting claims.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Derivations, applicable domains, and boundaries of enabled capabilities.

candidate_practices.name: Define the output around the downstream decision
candidate_practices.source_observation: These frameworks change what is returned, judged, or controlled.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: contribution scope becomes a concrete decision interface.
candidate_practices.application: Specify who uses the output, what choice it supports, and its retained constraints.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When downstream preferences or losses are unavailable, avoid asserting decision optimality.

support.specific_example: Critique-resilient judgments use localized human verification and joint solving/question-generation rankings.
Hierarchical extraction, intensity references, and scoring support controlled value-intensity study.
Pareto route sets expose competing synthesis criteria under a conditional search guarantee.
Risk-oriented prediction sets retain marginal coverage while addressing costly errors.

contrasts.contrast: Prediction, intervention, and guaranteed design organize an agenda, not demonstrated capabilities at every level.
Evidence levels and a checklist structure criticism; improved decision quality is not demonstrated here.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Decision rules, calibration, validity, and actual downstream evaluation.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Test claimed re-examination through semantic input substitution.
unusual_but_useful.application: Contrast sensitivity to changed evidence under self-reflection and user instruction.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Swap sensitivity does not establish a complete reasoning mechanism.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate structural sweeps from semantics-preserving perturbations.
unusual_but_useful.application: Describe which intervention changes difficulty and which should preserve the answer.
unusual_but_useful.limit: The extraction's lesson overextends matching to specific surface statistics.

unusual_but_useful.application: Distinguish representation drift from policy obfuscation before discussing penalties.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate exact and approximate symmetry claims.
unusual_but_useful.application: Name discrete groups separately from bounded continuous-rotation equivariance.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate algebraic reversibility from numerical reconstruction.
unusual_but_useful.application: Label structural, convergence, and reconstruction claims individually.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Use an analytical optimum to motivate a policy class.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain which solution structure informs parameterization.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Identify both constrained objects and implementation.
